$comment: Configure these Online Archive policies in MongoDB Atlas before go-live. See docs/data-management.md §Admin Help Page. TTL indexes are created by M001 migration; Online Archive requires Atlas console or Atlas API configuration.

policies.note: REQ-DATA-001; signal_runs active window 90 days per data-management.md
REQ-DATA-001; entry_signals active window 12 months per data-management.md
REQ-DATA-001; notifications active window 90 days per data-management.md

policies.archiveCondition: closed_at present and older than 12 months — open positions (no closed_at) are never archived
policies.note: REQ-DATA-001; positions archive 12 months after close; must use custom filter to exclude open positions
REQ-DATA-001; rme_events active window 24 months per data-management.md
REQ-DATA-001; trade_ledger immutable append-only; federated query endpoint required for FIFO calculations reaching archived records

policies.archiveCondition: created_at older than 12 months AND status in terminal state (matched, submission_failed, unresolved, orphan_ack)
policies.note: REQ-DATA-001; pending records older than 12 months are anomalous — surface to admin, do not archive
REQ-DATA-001; equity_curve long-term retention; append-only records never modified after writing

policies.archiveCondition: superseded_at present and older than 12 months
policies.note: REQ-DATA-001; current recommendation record is overwritten; superseded records archived after 12 months
REQ-DATA-001; audit_events immutable compliance log; active window 24 months per data-management.md
REQ-DATA-001; job_runs operational monitoring window 90 days per data-management.md
